headlines.title: Chase Lee traded from the Toronto Blue Jays to the Colorado Rockies
headlines.blurb: Toronto Blue Jays traded RHP Chase Lee to Colorado Rockies for cash.

headlines.title: Bobby Miller traded from the Los Angeles Dodgers to the Minnesota Twins
headlines.blurb: Minnesota Twins traded 1B Royce Lewis to Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Bobby Miller and C Francisco Espinoza.

headlines.title: Christian Koss traded from the San Francisco Giants to the Tampa Bay Rays
headlines.blurb: San Francisco Giants traded SS Christian Koss to Tampa Bay Rays for RHP Cole Stokes.

headlines.title: Braxton Roxby traded from the Washington Nationals to the Chicago Cubs
headlines.blurb: Washington Nationals traded RHP Braxton Roxby to Chicago Cubs for cash.

headlines.title: Johan Oviedo traded from the Boston Red Sox to the Arizona Diamondbacks
headlines.blurb: Arizona Diamondbacks traded LHP Luke Dotson and Future Considerations to Boston Red Sox for RHP Johan Oviedo.

headlines.title: Jordan Leasure traded from the Chicago White Sox to the Philadelphia Phillies
headlines.blurb: Chicago White Sox traded RHP Jordan Leasure to Philadelphia Phillies for RHP Christian Coppola.
